rule.name: CloseDereferencesUnopenedField
rule.message: This close method calls a field that only an open or start method assigns, so closing an object that was never opened throws a NullPointerException, and frameworks that close every registered stream after a failure see that exception instead of the original error. Check for null and reset the field (if (cursor != null) cursor.close(); then cursor = null), or create the resource in the constructor. A constructor, initializer or @PostConstruct method that calls the opener is not reported. An exception fits only when the class forbids closing before opening.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $openers := '^(?:open|doOpen|start|doStart|init|doInit|connect|doConnect)([A-Z_]\w*)?$', $closers := '^(?:close|doClose|stop|doStop|destroy|doDestroy|dispose|doDispose)$', $hooks := ('javax.annotation.PreDestroy', 'jakarta.annotation.PreDestroy'), $named := function($n, $name) { ($n/self::VariableAccess or $n/self::FieldAccess) and $n/@Name = $name } return //ClassDeclaration/ClassBody/MethodDeclaration [matches(@Name, $closers) or ModifierList/Annotation[some $hook in $hooks satisfies pmd-java:typeIs($hook)]] [empty(.//*[self::IfStatement or self::ConditionalExpression or self::ReturnStatement or self::TryStatement or self::SynchronizedStatement])] [empty(.//MethodCall[@MethodName = ('nonNull', 'isNull', 'requireNonNull', 'ofNullable', 'isPresent')])] [empty(.//InfixExpression[@Operator = ('&&', '||', '==', '!=')])] /Block//MethodCall[*[1][self::VariableAccess or self::FieldAccess]] [let $name := *[1]/@Name, $body := ancestor::ClassBody[1], $field := $body/FieldDeclaration[@Static = false()][not(pmd-java:modifiers() = 'final')][empty(ModifierList/Annotation)][ClassType] [VariableDeclarator[count(*) = 1][VariableId/@Name = $name]], $writes := $body//AssignmentExpression[*[1][$named(., $name)]][not(*[2][self::NullLiteral])] return exists($field) and exists($writes) and empty($body/Initializer) and empty(($body/ConstructorDeclaration | $body/Initializer | $body/MethodDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('javax.annotation.PostConstruct') or pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.annotation.PostConstruct')]]) //MethodCall[*[1][self::ArgumentList or self::ThisExpression]] [@MethodName = $writes/ancestor::MethodDeclaration[1]/@Name]) and empty($body/ConstructorDeclaration//AssignmentExpression[*[1][$named(., $name)]]) and (every $w in $writes satisfies exists($w/ancestor::MethodDeclaration[matches(@Name, $openers)]))]
